definition: Customer has not received a promised refund, or the refund is delayed.
Order not received, delayed, marked delivered but not received, or lost in transit.
Customer has been charged twice for a single order.
Scheduled pickup for return was not completed.
Customer reports that the app is crashing or not opening.
Customer's device cannot be found, paired or connected with a phone or laptop (pairing failure, not in Bluetooth list).
Customer reports rapid battery drain on their device.
Customer received an incorrect item instead of what was ordered.
Product was damaged during shipping or delivery.
Customer requests a copy of their invoice or has issues with GST details.
Customer's promotional code is not being accepted.
Customer inquires about the compatibility of a product with another device.
Customer's device is stuck during a firmware update.
Customer reports that one side of their audio device is not working.
Customer reports that the microphone is not picking up sound properly.
Customer's order status has not changed and is stuck on a previous status.
Customer is unable to access their account due to being locked out.
Customer inquires about the status of their warranty or repair claim.
Customer reports that the charging case is not functioning properly.
Customer needs to change the delivery address for their order.
Customer requests to cancel their order.

Customer received a different variant of the product than what was ordered.
Customer reports damage to the strap of a wearable device.
Customer experiences issues with the app after an update.
Product is dead, bricked or will not power on, and no more specific tag fits.
Bluetooth connection keeps cutting out or dropping while the device is in use.
